title: 15-minute signals, round 2: trader positioning, basis, BTC lead and a walk-forward linear model
why_round_2: Round 1 (prereg_15m_microstructure.json, 5 order-flow hypotheses x 5 coins) passed 0 of 25. The user asked for another serious attempt at a 15m long/short signal. Round 2 uses data round 1 did not have: open interest, long/short account ratios, taker volume ratio and the futures premium index. Testing a second family after a failure raises the chance of a false discovery; the untouched one-shot holdout below is the guard against that.

data.prices: Binance USD-M futures 15m klines with taker-buy volume (same files as round 1)
data.positioning: Binance futures 'metrics' archive, 5-minute rows: sum_open_interest, count_toptrader_long_short_ratio, sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio, count_long_short_ratio, sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio
data.premium: Binance premiumIndexKlines 15m (close of the premium index)
data.state_at_registration: files downloaded; no statistic, chart or relationship has been computed or looked at

alignment_no_lookahead.bar: 15m bar with open time t closes at t+15m; the signal is computed at that close
alignment_no_lookahead.metrics: the latest metrics row with create_time <= t+15m-5m (one 5-minute row of extra lag, in case rows are published late)
alignment_no_lookahead.premium: the premium kline with the same open time t (it closes at t+15m)

trade_mechanics: identical to round 1: entry at next bar open, exit at close of the 8th bar held (2h) or a 3 x ATR(14) protective stop touched intrabar; one position per coin; signals during a trade are ignored
cost_secondary_descriptive_only: 0.10% (maker entry 0.02% + taker exit 0.06% + 0.02% slippage); reported, cannot make a test pass

definitions.z(x): (x - mean) / std over the prior 2880 bars (30 days) of the same 15m-sampled quantity, current bar excluded
definitions.sigma_k: std of k-bar returns over the prior 2880 bars
definitions.dOI4: log(OI now / OI 4 bars earlier), using aligned OI

hypotheses.P1_OI_UNWIND_FADE: r4 < -sigma4 and z(dOI4) < -2 -> long; r4 > +sigma4 and z(dOI4) < -2 -> short (moves made by positions closing tend to exhaust)
hypotheses.P2_OI_BUILD_FOLLOW: r4 > +sigma4 and z(dOI4) > 2 -> long; r4 < -sigma4 and z(dOI4) > 2 -> short (moves made by new positions tend to continue)
hypotheses.P3_CROWD_FADE: z(acct) > 2 -> short; z(acct) < -2 -> long (fade a crowded retail side)
hypotheses.P4_TOP_VS_CROWD: d = z(top) - z(acct); d > 2 -> long; d < -2 -> short (follow top traders when they disagree with the crowd)
hypotheses.P5_BASIS_FADE: z(prem) > 2.5 -> short; z(prem) < -2.5 -> long (stretched futures premium reverts)
hypotheses.P6_BTC_LEAD: alts only (ETH, BNB, SOL, TRX): BTC r1 > 3 sigma1(BTC) and alt r1 < sigma1(alt) -> long alt; BTC r1 < -3 sigma1(BTC) and alt r1 > -sigma1(alt) -> short alt (lagging catch-up)

features: sin and cos of hour of day (UTC)
P7_LINEAR_MODEL.model: logistic regression, L2 penalty lambda = 1.0 on features standardized with training-set mean and std; fitted by Newton iterations
P7_LINEAR_MODEL.walk_forward: refit at the start of every calendar month on all earlier bars whose target is fully known before that month; first predictions 2022-07-01
P7_LINEAR_MODEL.signal: long if predicted p >= the 95th percentile of the model's own in-sample training predictions; short if p <= the 5th percentile

family: P1-P5 and P7 x 5 coins + P6 x 4 alts = 34 tests
statistic: mean net return per trade (%), block bootstrap with 1-day blocks

adopt_rule.discovery: mean > 0, Romano-Wolf p_adj < 0.10 across the 34 tests, at least 100 trades
adopt_rule.validation: mean > 0 and one-sided 90% lower bound > 0, at least 50 trades
adopt_rule.holdout: run once, only for tests that passed both; at least 30 trades and mean > 0 -> shown to the user as a candidate and sent to a live demo forward test; otherwise rejected
adopt_rule.no_pass: if nothing passes, no 15-minute signal is shipped and the user is told

no_changes_after_seeing_results: definitions, parameters, windows, costs and rules above are fixed
